name: bcf_to_gt_parquet
title: BCF to GT Parquet (QC + Consolidate)
summary: QC a batch of BCF/VCF files in parallel, then consolidate to gt_long.parquet and variant_metadata.parquet

inputSpec.name: input_file_list
inputSpec.label: Input file list (CSV or Parquet)
inputSpec.help: CSV or Parquet with columns: vcf_file_id, vcf_index_id. Each row is one BCF/index pair to process.

inputSpec.name: min_gq
inputSpec.label: Minimum GQ
inputSpec.help: Genotype quality threshold; at or below is set to missing (default: 10)

inputSpec.name: min_lad
inputSpec.label: Minimum LAD sum
inputSpec.help: Minimum sum of LAD allele depths; below is set to missing (default: 8)

inputSpec.name: max_missing
inputSpec.label: Max missing fraction
inputSpec.help: Maximum fraction of missing genotypes per variant (default: 0.1)

inputSpec.name: fasta_ref
inputSpec.label: Reference FASTA
inputSpec.help: Reference FASTA for bcftools norm (optional, shared across all process_file subjobs)

inputSpec.name: fasta_ref_index
inputSpec.label: Reference FASTA index (.fai)
inputSpec.help: Samtools .fai index for the reference FASTA (required if fasta_ref is provided)

outputSpec.name: gt_long_parquet
outputSpec.label: Long-format genotype Parquet
outputSpec.help: Consolidated sparse non-ref genotypes: id, sample, gt

outputSpec.name: variant_metadata_parquet
outputSpec.label: Variant metadata Parquet
outputSpec.help: Per-variant stats: id, chrom, pos, ref, alt, sc_cohort, ac_cohort, mac_cohort
